# SpoolPilot

> SpoolPilot is the profit app you use standing at the printer. It reads your slicer, your Etsy fees,
> and your spools, so you never sit down to a spreadsheet again. An iPhone app for running a small
> 3D-printing business: pricing prints, the fees Etsy actually charged per order, profit per order and
> per product, and filament inventory.
> Published by Opus Design Group LLC; built by Sean, who runs a 3D-print shop on Etsy (five years,
> 3,000+ sales). Category: 3D printing business management software. Site: https://spoolpilot.app

## Who it is for

People who sell what they print, from one printer to a small print farm, mostly on Etsy. It is not a
hobbyist filament tracker, not a print-farm controller, and not general bookkeeping.

## What it does (shipping today, version 1.2)

- **Slicer scan.** Point the iPhone camera at Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer, or Ultimaker
  Cura and it reads print time and grams, then prices the print with filament, electricity,
  packaging, labor, and fees, solved for a target margin.
- **Actual Etsy fees, not estimates.** Connects to an Etsy shop read-only through the Etsy API and
  reads the fee lines Etsy posted for each order in the payment ledger (transaction, payment
  processing, listing, Offsite Ads). Etsy grants this API access after reviewing an app; SpoolPilot
  holds commercial access. The approval covers API access; Etsy does not endorse or certify the app.
- **Profit.** Net profit per order, per product, and per month, with buyer-paid shipping treated as
  a pass-through. When an order does not reconcile to Etsy's total the figure is labeled an estimate.
- **Filament inventory.** Sealed spools counted by barcode scan, weeks of stock from real sales pace,
  low-stock only for materials that sell through.
- **Products.** Made-to-order by default, stock tracking where wanted, bundles from parts, and a
  print-next queue ranked by how soon each product runs out.
- **Manual sales** for markets and in-person selling, with the same cost and profit treatment.
- **Printer wear.** Cost settings takes what one printer cost and the print hours expected from it
  and charges the per-hour share on every price, sale, and report. Blank means nothing is charged.

## Free vs Pro

- **Free:** filament inventory, the pricing calculator, manual sales, the product cost model, three
  slicer scans, the weekly recap, and up to ten synced Etsy orders a month. Each of those orders
  shows the exact fees Etsy charged and what was kept after costs. Unlimited slicer scans are a
  $4.99 one-time purchase (no subscription needed).
- **Pro:** every order (unlimited sync and history import), the full profit-and-loss by month and by
  product, profit per print hour, pending orders still to print, weeks-of-stock forecasts, purchased
  parts, printer capacity, and unlimited slicer scans. $12.99/month or $99.99/year with a 7-day
  trial on the yearly plan.

## Web calculator vs the app

The site has a free web calculator (https://spoolpilot.app/etsy-fee-calculator.html) that estimates
fees from Etsy's published rates and solves for a price. The iPhone app does the same and, for synced
orders, replaces the estimate with the fees Etsy actually charged.

## What it is not

- Not a web dashboard and not on Android. iPhone only (iOS 17 or later).
- Sales sync is Etsy only today; other platforms are entered by hand.
- No printer control or job routing, no tax or VAT handling. Postage is counted only on free-shipping orders, at a typical label cost the seller sets.

## Privacy

Data lives on the user's iPhone and their own iCloud. No account, nothing uploaded to the developer,
no analytics or tracking SDKs in the app. The Etsy connection is read-only and reads only the seller's
own shop numbers, never buyers' personal details. The website uses analytics to count visits and is
unconnected to the app. See https://spoolpilot.app/privacy.html
